body.intent: A parity property test checks that the interim model, the index's write model and a fresh strict fold of the log agree on random logs (two landed heads, rebases dropping entry files, dry-run pending entries), each disagreement is fixed on the non-strict side with the strict engine as the spec, and internal/api's tests run on the index, as production does. Evidence: the model rules are implemented three times (api/model.go, internal/model, write_indexed.go); testCtx sets no IndexPath, so all ~770 api tests run the interim path.
body.title: Parity harness
